parts.refutation: 'per-cell floor' fails on the datasheet's stated figures. SLUSBV4D 5.5 gives scaling factor K 0.198 to 0.202 for VC1-VSS and VC2-VC1 (+/-1 %, +/-30 mV at 3.0 V) and ADC gain error +/-0.2 % typ, +/-0.8 % max with the unit '/FSR' (VFS = VREF1, about 1.22 V), over -0.1 V to 0.8 x VFS. At the cell input (K = 0.2) 0.8 % of FSR is 48.6 to 49.2 mV; with K and the 157 uV offset (0.8 mV) the worst case is +/-79.4 to +/-80.0 mV, over the 75 mV of V95. P2's 'about +/-54 mV' reads the gain error as a percentage of the reading (24 mV + 30 mV); the datasheet does not say that. The TRM (SLUUBT5C) states no cell-voltage accuracy either; it offers Calibration:Voltage:Cell Gain (data flash 12101), which could remove K and the gain error at a calibration point, but no datasheet figure bounds the residual drift (150 ppm/degC) over 0 to 50 degC. The same rows are in the BQ40Z50-R2 and BQ4050 datasheets. Also read, not refuting: the datasheet 6.3.2 lists an 'open cell connection permanent failure' that the TRM has no section for (its section 4 list has none); balance lead open rests on the pull-down and CUV logic as P2 states.
